trigger_condition.shape_trigger: Distribution parameters with incompatible scalar, batch, or event dimensions, such as 0-dimensional loc with matrix covariance
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: Passing a 0-dimensional scalar tensor as loc to torch.distributions.MultivariateNormal with a covariance_matrix of shape [1, 1], or more generally parameters whose broadcast/event shapes are inconsistent.

bug_oracle.description: Process terminated with SIGFPE when incompatible distribution parameter shapes were provided to torch.distributions.MultivariateNormal.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Mutate distribution parameter shapes across scalar, vector, and matrix combinations, focusing on mismatches between loc and covariance_matrix dimensions.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Construct torch.distributions.MultivariateNormal instances with incompatible batch or event shapes, including torch.tensor(0.0) or torch.zeros(()) as loc and torch.eye(1) * sigma as covariance_matrix.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Inject shape invariants that enforce consistent event dimensions between loc and covariance parameters, and vary or bypass validation checks to expose unhandled shape combinations.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Initialize distribution parameters with mismatched shapes, then invoke methods such as sample(), log_prob(), or entropy() to trigger shape handling code paths.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Monitor for crash signals such as SIGFPE or SIGSEGV, unexpected RuntimeError exceptions, or results inconsistent with expected shape validation failures.
